description: Deep physics concepts requiring high-dimensional abstract reasoning

probes.name: Quantum superposition
support_texts: Explain quantum superposition. Why isn't a particle in a definite position before measurement?

probes.name: Wave-particle duality
support_texts: How can light be both a wave and a particle? Explain the double-slit experiment.

probes.name: Heisenberg uncertainty
support_texts: Explain the Heisenberg uncertainty principle. Why can't we know both position and momentum precisely?

probes.name: Quantum entanglement
support_texts: What is quantum entanglement? Why did Einstein call it 'spooky action at a distance'?

probes.name: Spacetime curvature
support_texts: How does mass curve spacetime? Explain Einstein's view of gravity.

probes.name: Time dilation
support_texts: Why does time pass slower near massive objects? Explain gravitational time dilation.

probes.name: Black hole thermodynamics
support_texts: What is the black hole information paradox? Why is it important?

probes.name: Entropy and time arrow
support_texts: Why does entropy increase? How does this relate to the arrow of time?

probes.name: Standard Model
support_texts: What are the fundamental particles in the Standard Model? How are forces mediated?

probes.name: Symmetry breaking
support_texts: What is spontaneous symmetry breaking? How does it give particles mass?

probes.name: Renormalization
support_texts: What is renormalization in quantum field theory? Why is it necessary?

probes.name: Dark matter
support_texts: What evidence do we have for dark matter? Why can't we see it?

probes.name: Cosmological constant
support_texts: What is the cosmological constant problem? Why is it called the worst prediction in physics?

probes.name: Holographic principle
support_texts: What is the holographic principle? How might 3D reality emerge from 2D information?

probes.name: String theory basics
support_texts: What are the basic ideas of string theory? What problem does it try to solve?

probes.name: Quantum gravity
support_texts: Why is it hard to combine quantum mechanics with general relativity?

probes.name: Multiverse hypothesis
support_texts: What is the multiverse hypothesis? What scientific basis might it have?

probes.name: Conservation and symmetry
support_texts: How does Noether's theorem connect conservation laws to symmetries?

probes.name: Phase transitions
support_texts: What happens at a phase transition? Explain critical phenomena.

probes.name: Emergent phenomena
support_texts: What are emergent phenomena? Why is 'more different' as Anderson argued?
